name: Mini Flexi Pets
eyebrow: Tiny dragons and animals. Mix and match: 2 for $1 or 12 for $5.
description: Mix and match tiny 3D-printed dragons and animal friends in one collection. Choose a crystal dragon, winged dragon, fin dragon, tiger, fox, duck, penguin, rabbit, wolf, otter, woodland friend, or platypus. About an inch long, with colorful articulated bodies and fun joints to fidget with. Pick any mix: 2 for $1 or 12 for $5. Keychain versions are listed separately.
priceNote: Mix any mini dragon or animal design. Every 12 pets are $5; remaining pets are $0.50 each. Bundle savings apply automatically in your bag.

name: Halloween Figures
description: Bring a little spooky character to your desk or seasonal display. Choose a grinning pumpkin with a ribbed body, a green monster with dark clothes, or a black bear with white skeleton details and mismatched eyes. Each one has a rounded character shape and visible printed texture. Priced individually at $2, so you can build your own little Halloween crew.

name: Skeleton Figure
description: A white skeleton character with a rounded skull, contrasting black eyes, and a detailed ribcage. The visible print layers give this little figure its own texture. A simple addition to a desk, shelf, or growing character collection. Sold individually for $2.

name: Little Character
description: A rounded white character with oversized black eyes and a simple, friendly shape. Browse the photos for a closer look at the printed details. A simple addition to a desk, shelf, or growing character collection. Sold individually for $2.

name: Gold Dragon
description: A small dragon with curved horns, wide eyes, and a gold-colored finish that catches the light across its printed layers. A cheerful little piece for a shelf or desk. Sold individually for $2.

name: Rainbow Rabbit
eyebrow: Long ears. A lively little gradient.
description: A bright rabbit with tall ears, a long segmented body, and a mix of pink, yellow, and teal. Its changing colors make the printed details stand out from head to tail. Add one to your collection for $2; the exact color placement can vary between prints.

name: Animal Keychains & Charms
eyebrow: Your favorite little animal, to go. $2 each.
description: Take a colorful little companion along on your keys or bag. These 3D-printed animal charms have articulated bodies and playful details. Browse the woodland collection photos and choose your design below. Key ring and loop-strap attachments vary by design. Each animal charm is $2, including its attachment.

name: Mini Dragon Keychain
eyebrow: A little dragon for everyday adventures.
description: A little fantasy for your keys or bag. Browse the woodland collection photos for green, pink, and purple articulated dragons with sculpted details and metal key rings. Ask about current colors and styles. Each mini dragon keychain is $2.

name: Platypus Keychain
eyebrow: A very small agent of adventure. $2 each.
description: A teal platypus with an orange bill and tail and a playful segmented body. See it alongside the other mini pets in the woodland collection photos. A short chain and metal ring keep this little companion close to your keys or bag. Sold individually for $2.

name: Ocean Figures & Keychains
description: Bring a little ocean character to your collection. Choose a gray spotted shark with a segmented body and key ring, or a blue-and-white hammerhead figure with a wide head and sculpted fins. The photographed attachment is included where shown. Each small sea creature is $2.

name: Articulated Dragons
eyebrow: Long tails. Layered scales. A world of color.
description: These longer dragons are made to show off: sculpted heads, rows of raised details, and segmented bodies that curve into expressive poses. Browse mint rainbow, pink rainbow, teal-and-pink, red-and-yellow, gold-horn, and pastel examples. Choose a style to ask about its size, available colors, and price.

name: Mini Tumbler Keychain
eyebrow: The tiniest take on a favorite cup.
description: A miniature white tumbler charm with a handle, teal lid, and matching straw detail. Its removable lid adds a playful touch to this little accessory, and the metal ring lets it travel on a bag or set of keys. A decorative miniature; ask us about pricing and available colors.

name: Desk Fidgets
description: Choose a purple nested-star design with repeating points or a blue gear-style fidget with interlocking shapes. Each has a distinct printed pattern and movement to explore. Ask about current colors and pricing.

name: Forest Vase
eyebrow: A little woodland for your shelf.
description: A tall decorative vessel with raised trees and a color gradient that moves from earthy tones into green. The textured forest wraps around the outside, giving it a different view from every angle. Ask about dimensions, available colors, and pricing before choosing a spot for it.

name: Textured Holiday Tree
eyebrow: A small tree with plenty of texture.
description: A green holiday tree with a knit-like surface, stacked branches, and a bright yellow star. The repeating texture catches the light across its printed layers, adding a cozy detail to a shelf or seasonal display. Ask about size, colors, and pricing.

name: Honeycomb Organizer
eyebrow: A place for the little things.
description: An orange organizer with rows of open hexagonal compartments and a geometric honeycomb shape. The divided layout keeps small items easy to see and gives your workspace a bright graphic detail. Ask about compartment dimensions, suitable uses, and pricing.

name: Fortnite Display Sign
eyebrow: Bold lettering for your gaming space.
description: A yellow display sign with chunky raised Fortnite lettering on a matching base. Its sculpted letters bring a bright focal point to a shelf or gaming setup. Ask us about size, available colors, and pricing.
